title: Air-Fried Spiced Tofu
description: Crispy, garam-masala-spiced tofu cubes from the air fryer, for folding into curries and sauces or topping a bowl.
instructions: Press the 350g block of tofu for 20 minutes, in a tofu press or wrapped in paper towels under a heavy pan.
Cut the pressed tofu into 3/4–1 inch cubes and put them in a bowl.
Toss the cubes with 1 tsp canola oil, 1/2 tsp garam masala, 1/4 tsp smoked paprika and 1/4 tsp kosher salt.
Sprinkle 2 tsp cornstarch over the tofu and toss gently until no white powder shows.
Air fry at 400°F for 12–15 minutes in a single layer, shaking the basket at the halfway point, until golden and crisp. Work in batches if the cubes are crowded.
Serve right away, or fold the cubes into a sauce just before serving so they stay crisp.
notes: Protein density is about 8.9g per 100 kcal. Tofu brands vary, so check your label: extra-firm blocks run about 6–9g fat per 100g. The drier the tofu after pressing, the crispier the result. Store leftovers separately from any sauce, and re-crisp them in the air fryer at 400°F for 3–4 minutes. Swap the spices to suit the dish: try cumin and chili powder, or a little soy sauce and sesame oil.
